notes: Evidence in the case notes. The label is written on by the game.
prompt: top-down flat lay photograph, shot on 35mm film, soft directional light from the upper left, fine film grain, muted colours, true to life wear and patina, sharp focus, a single microcassette tape from a telephone answering machine, small black plastic shell, a clear window showing the two little tape reels, a completely blank white paper label, light scuffs, lying flat and seen straight down from directly above, the object with its long side horizontal, centred and whole in the frame with a wide margin all round, isolated on a plain matte mid-grey seamless background with a soft shadow, nothing else in the picture, no text, no lettering, no logos, no watermark
purpose: Photographed-looking base pictures for what Mack carries in place of the phone (story/phone.md): the pager (ポケベル), the ring-bound notebook and the things tucked into it. Each is one object seen straight down on a plain ground, to be cut out and used as a surface the game draws on: every display, page, card and label is BLANK, because digits, handwriting and print are composited in the engine. Design reference: the mock-up at https://claude.ai/artifact/HmLoAUjpEfS679J4BH87pJ. Nothing here goes into the game without the user's approval.
